 P.C.:

What the Petitioner seeks is enforcement of the award passed under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act,1894 and payment of compensation.
The Award is passed on 9 March 2009.
Petitioner seeks compensation along with interest.
2. However, in the petition, Petitioner has stated that there are no delay and laches.
There is no explanation whatsoever in the Petition for the time span between 2009 to 2022.
Writ Petition could have been dismissed on the grounds of laches alone.
